thread:
ida (docs): Heads-up: publishing a small but breaking docs update to standardize sampling config across quickstarts and SDKs. We're moving the top-level `temperature`/`top_p` keys into a nested `sampling` object (e.g., `sampling: { temperature, top_p }`). This will affect all code examples and some SDK helper signatures. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1904

noah (sdk): Short impact note: SDK convenience helpers that accepted `temperature` directly will accept both forms for two releases via a compat shim, but examples will show the new `sampling` shape. Most users will only need a tiny change.

alex (devex): I'll add migration snippets for JS/Python/Go and a small CLI tool `docs/scripts/convert-sampling.sh` that rewrites examples in repos. Also planning a one-page "Sampling config migration" recipe.

ravi (product): Timeline? We want this in for the next docs flip and highlight in the changelog. Also need to inform Dedicated customers because some of them patch defaults in automation.

ida (docs): Target plan: preview deploy tomorrow AM, canary flip 48h after, full flip next week. Deprecation window: 30 days after flip during which runtime accepts both shapes and emits Deprecation-Warning headers. After 30 days we'll only accept `sampling`. We'll add an in-doc banner and a changelog note.

maya (support): I'll prepare KB and canned replies showing quick diffs. I'll also run a grep across top accounts to find any automated tooling that sets `temperature` at runtime.

ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/1904 (:rocket:)

noah (sdk): Example old vs new for copy/paste: 
```js
// OLD
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'Explain X', temperature: 0.7 })
// NEW
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'Explain X', sampling: { temperature: 0.7 } })
```

alex (devex): We'll also add a tiny helper in SDKs `normalizeSampling(opts)` that accepts both shapes and normalizes for internal use. PRs incoming to SDK repos.

noah (sdk): Plan: publish patch SDKs with the shim + runtime warnings in the next 48 hours. We'll remove shim after 2 minor releases.

ravi (product): Please include a short note in the Dedicated customer email: why we changed it (consistency across APIs + easier extension for new sampling knobs) and the exact dates for preview/cutover/stop-accepting-old-shape.

maya (support): Ack. I'll add sample troubleshooting where customers see 400s and a quick migration checklist.

deploy-bot: Canary flip scheduled: 2026-11-03 16:00 UTC (window 25m)

ida (docs): Action items: 1) @alex publish migration recipe + CLI script 2) @noah SDK patch + compat shim 3) @maya KB + top-account outreach 4) @ravi Dedicated comms. Please post PR links and ack here.

noah (sdk): Ack  Opening PRs now.

alex (devex): Ack, will post script link when ready.

maya (support): Ack, starting KB draft.

ida (docs): Thanks all 680 Keeping this thread as the source of truth. Ping me for blockers or if you find examples that need manual fixes.
